specs.title: admin selection attaches the transformer to the clicked object
admin drag is transient and commits once
admin resize re-renders only the resized layer and commits once
admin rotation renders nothing until release and commits once
an admin multi-object drag is one atomic commit
admin zoom: the same screen drag moves the document half as far at 2x
an admin-locked layer cannot be dragged
Escape abandons a live drag and leaves the editor usable
pointercancel abandons a live drag
losing the window abandons a live drag
hiding the tab abandons a live drag
Escape abandons a live RESIZE without resizing the object
Escape abandons a live ROTATION without rotating the object
Escape with no gesture running still reaches the editor and clears the selection
a cancelled gesture is never autosaved
two cancellations in a row do not break the third, real gesture
an object near the top edge can still be rotated
the page still lines up exactly with the artwork underneath it
a click in the gutter outside the page clears the selection
the fixture mounts the real editor with no seeded database
a 20-step drag writes nothing and renders nothing until release, then commits once
drag undo and redo restore exact document geometry
a 20-step resize re-renders only the resized layer and commits once
resize undo and redo restore exact size
a 20-step rotation renders nothing until release, then commits once
rotation undo and redo
a multi-object drag is ONE atomic transaction however many objects move
moving a group moves every member rigidly as one transaction
a locked layer cannot be dragged and writes nothing
a hidden layer neither renders nor intercepts selection
front and back pages carry their own layers
entering crop mode creates no history and writes nothing
a 20-step crop pan writes nothing until release, then commits once
a wheel-zoom burst is ONE grouped crop commit
crop Done commits a still-pending gesture exactly once
crop Done with no change writes nothing
crop pan undo and redo restore the exact crop
crop zoom undo and redo restore the exact zoom
Cancel after several committed crop gestures rolls back document AND history
Cancel during the wheel settle delay never commits afterwards
pinch crop stays transient, commits once on lift, and Cancel rolls it back
changing page during crop finalizes it once and no old-page timer fires
selecting another object during crop is Done for the crop
grid crop pan is transient until release, then commits once
grid crop Cancel after a commit restores the slot and its history
grid crop Cancel during the wheel settle delay never commits afterwards
grid crop undo and redo
editing text commits the new value without creating a second layer
selecting existing text layers never creates a new one
holding a gesture past the autosave debounce never saves transient geometry
Cancel after the modified crop already autosaved leaves the ORIGINAL crop saved
an in-flight save cannot mark the restored document saved after Cancel
20 layers: one commit per drag, no workspace re-render
50 layers: one commit per drag, no workspace re-render
100 layers: one commit per drag, no workspace re-render
200 layers: one commit per drag, no workspace re-render

resizing a multi-selection scales every member as one transaction
a group resizes as one object and commits once
a text box side drag changes the wrap width, not the type size
a text corner drag scales the TYPE rather than stretching the glyphs

resize survives undo and redo exactly
